description.name: PaymentHooks
description.long: Connects WHMCS to a PaymentHooks deployment. PaymentHooks hosts the checkout, routes to the underlying gateway (Razorpay for INR and others), and handles subscriptions and refunds. This module creates hosted checkout sessions, redirects the client to pay, and reconciles invoices from signed webhooks.
features: Hosted redirect checkout on your PaymentHooks domain
One-time payments with full and partial refunds
Signed webhook reconciliation with duplicate protection
